description: Korean workplace accident: is it a 'serious industrial accident' under the Serious Accidents Punishment Act (중대재해처벌법 제2조: 1+ death, 2+ injured needing 6+ months of treatment from the same accident, or 3+ occupational illness cases from the same hazard within a year) and/or a 'serious accident' under the Occupational Safety and Health Act (시행규칙 제3조: 1+ death, 2+ simultaneously injured needing 3+ months of care, or 10+ injured/ill at once). Applies the 5-worker exclusion and the 2024-01-27 phase-in for under-50 workplaces, and states penalty ranges (death: 1+ years prison or up to 1B KRW fine for the responsible executive, 5B KRW for the company) and reporting duties. Information only; no case handling.

illness1y.description: Occupational illness cases from the same hazard within 1 year

injured3m.description: Injured needing 3+ months of care, at the same time

injured6m.description: Injured needing 6+ months of treatment, same accident

injuredTotal.description: Injured or ill workers at the same time (total)
